svg.aria-label: 07 Now. Sahl V1: One ministry, one service, live on Azure end to end. JADS app: Approved and live on the Apple App Store. In progress: OpenTelemetry traces for Sahl, sent to Application Insights. Studying: Parallel computing with CUDA, and hardware–software co-design.
